name: Vision Motors
verdict: Vision Motors is a trading division of Vision Investments Limited — a Fijian company listed on the South Pacific Stock Exchange. Nothing found.
note: Fiji Rugby partner since a three-year 'official vehicle supplier' deal announced in July 2023 (fijivillage); the Vision Motors logo appears on the match shorts in 2026. No state or fund in the ownership chain, and no court, regulator, UN body or major-NGO human-rights finding found.
